notes: Phase 5 fixes (stream 5.8a). Same seeds, tiers and policy as phase5-3-storylines-after.json, where contract standoffs did not trigger. Cause: opening snapshot deals of players aged 20-30 ran 78-183 weeks (none reached the old 6-12-week window in season 1; 10 of 594 top-3 players worldwide had a deal ending by week 64, 3 of them Ambitious/Mercenary), the managed club is never auto-renewed (AI renewals apply to AI clubs only), and 28% of top-3 players are Ambitious or Mercenary. Fix: opening deals have already run a seeded share of their length; the trigger is the final year (6-52 weeks left) of a top-five player, at most 2 a season, kind cooldown 10 weeks; waiting ends in a transfer request after 8 weeks. Result: contract standoffs per managed season [2, 1, 0] (seed 3's starters include no Ambitious/Mercenary player with a deal in its final year). Amicability spread (save v10): rifts per managed season [0, 0, 0] (before [0, 2, 0]); AI administrations 0.
